title: Private Vancouver to Squamish With Sea to Sky Gondola DayTrip
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on an unforgettable adventure along the route to the 2010 Winter Olympics and the renowned Whistler resort with our premier tour. Departing from Vancouver, journey along the breathtaking "Sea-to-Sky Highway," traversing towering 7,000-foot mountains, British Columbia's third-highest waterfall, and the world's second-largest granite monolith. Our award-winning tour guide will immerse you in the region's captivating history and current events. This comprehensive day tour features stops at the picturesque Whistler Village, the stunning Shannon Falls, and an opportunity to delve into the area's rich heritage with our expert local guide. Explore the charming village boutiques, hike scenic forest trails, or simply relax and appreciate the spectacular mountain vistas – customize your experience.
